head_commit.message:
build(deps): adopt onevcs 0.51.2 and onevcs-testing 0.19.2

The release the operation-progress producer supplied for manager landings.
Its source (7059e0e0) contains onevcs 886120ab (onevcs #403); onevcs-testing
0.19.2 requires exactly =0.51.2, so the pair moves as one and the lock still
resolves a single registry onevcs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
